contentHtml:
In-game quest objective markers are available in WoW: Forever, allowing for easier navigation without needing additional addons.

With WoW: Forever being built on the Retail client, the game has taken some questing system improvements from Retail. This includes quest objectives and areas now showing on the map, mobs indicating whether they are needed for a quest, and more. There is one feature available in the Retail client that players can enable: the in-game quest objective markers.



By typing the following command into the chat box, a yellow diamond will appear directly in the world for a selected quest:

/console showInGameNavigation 1
This yellow diamond marks your chosen quest objective directly in the world without opening your map or using an addon. If your chosen quest is ready to turn in, or you're on a quest with a specific location to go to, the in-game navigation can show you exactly where it is.

 


This feature is particularly useful when an objective is above or below you, as elevation isn't shown well on a 2D map. The yellow diamond will be located in the exact spot you need to go.

contentHtml:
To complete this week's Gold Quest for level 60 characters, players must complete Blackrock Spire and Blackrock Depths.

BRD GuideUBRS GuideLBRS Guide


Once a character hits level 60, they can pick up a Weekly quest from Booty Bay. While the last two weeks required players to do Dire Maul, this week's quest is In Demand - Blackrock Legal Records, which requires completing Blackrock Spire and Blackrock Depths.
Acquire Nefarion's Remit from General Drakkisath in Blackrock Spire, Overseer's License from Overlord Wyrmthalak in Blackrock Spire, and Bronzebeard Wedding Contract from Emperor Thaurissan in Blackrock Depths, and bring them to Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay.
Similar to last week, completing this quest grants you an Undermine Satchel, which can contain up to 100 gold and some extra materials.
  • Gold Nugget - Sells for 10g
  • Huge Quartz Gem - Sells for 20g
  • Silver Necklace - Sells for 40g
  • Gold Ring - Sells for 100g
Due to the Wowhead Looter, the Undermine Satchel has many more confirmed drops of the crafting materials that can be in the bag. Check out the item page for all the data we have so far.

contentHtml:
Blizzard has released a video going over WoW: Forever's PvP system, highlighting Honor rewards, Rank rewards, and Battlegrounds!

WoW: Forever PvP Guide




This video takes you through everything about WoW: Forever's PvP system:
  • Honor points no longer determine your rank.
  • Rank points are earned through daily and weekly sources, weekly battlegrounds, new season's journey quests, and certain World PvP events (Gurubashi), making the ranked climb more varied and predictable.
  • Honor points are used as currency to get PvP rewards.
  • Rank points determine which rewards are available, Honor points is what you spend to acquire them.
  • At low ranks, you get Rare quality gear
  • Once you reach Rank 8 (Knight-Captain/Legionnaire) and can upgrade the gear into Epic quality gear.
  • At Rank 14, you unlock Epic weapons, equal in power with raiding gear.
  • The biggest source of Rank points is the Season Journey -- each week a new quest will be available for rank points.
  • There is catch-up for the Season Journey quests.
  • You can expect to hit max rank around halfway through the season.

contentHtml:
The Auction House minimum deposit has finally been reduced back down to 1 Copper.

It's been almost two weeks since launch and over a week since Blizzard announced that the Auction House deposit would be changing. With the weekly reset, the change is finally here! The Auction House no longer requires a minimum deposit of 1 Silver for every item.

 


For the faction-specific auction houses, the deposit should now strictly follow this formula:

DurationDeposit Cost
2 Hours5% of Vendor Price
8 Hours20% of Vendor Price
24 Hours60% of Vendor Price


This is a great change for the cheaper materials in the early levels, as players won't be putting up a deposit more than the items are worth!

contentHtml:
Blizzard has posted hotfixes for today, which includes damage and health increases to UBRS and improvements to pain points in the Shen'dralas zone.

For Questing
  • Many Shen'dralas quests and pacing have been improved, with quest drops dropping for the entire party.
  • The final quest in a main quest chain, "Agamaggan's Blood," which required you to do RFD (Level 40) after Mauradon (Level 50) can now be completed outside the dungeon.
For End Game
  • Upper Blackrock Spire damage and health of enemies has been increased when a bug was fixed.
  • Soulforge Armor for tanks now has Spell Power instead of Strength.
For Everyday Players
  • Sleeping Bags have to be placed on the ground and now have a unique aura to indicate when you're in it.
Blizzard
View Original
November 17, 2026

Camping
  • Mounted Players will no longer be permitted to sleep while saddled up atop the Cozy Sleeping Bag.
  • Cozy Sleeping Bag can now be placed in specific locations, like hunter traps.
  • Cozy Sleeping Bag will now provide a Resting aura indicating when you are within its area of effect.
Classes
  • Might of Stormwind and Warchief’s Blessing should now always correctly cancel on death.
  • Might of Stormwind and Warchief’s Blessing are no longer applied to non-players.
  • Shaman
    • Fixed an issue where Flurry incorrectly lost stacks when Windfury totem attacks landed.
Dungeons
  • Upper Blackrock Spire
    • Corrected an issue causing enemy health and damage to be significantly lower than intended.
    • Developers’ notes: This should bring UBRS back in line with its intended difficulty, and it again requires a full complement of diligent players to complete.
Enemies and NPCs
  • Thousand Needles - Fixed an issue where a Pesterhide Snarler or Needles Cougar could spawn inside a rock.
  • Thousand Needles - Fixed an issue where a Gravelysnout Digger or Surveyour could path inside a rock.
Items
  • Shadow Priests can now hold a Night Watchman’s Torch.
  • Escape Plan now has correct range and damage values.
  • Corrected Whiteout Staff and Crackling Staff so that they have the same stats: 25 Stamina, 25 Intellect, 74 Spell Power from Weapon damage.
  • Paladin
    • Soulforge Armor (upgraded Dungeon Set for tanks) now has Spell Power (was Strength).
    • Developers’ notes: We are leaning more into Paladin tanks favoring Spell Power as their primary stat for dealing damage.
Legacy
  • Reagent Economy should no longer randomly stop working.
Player versus Player
  • Fixed an issue allowing players to mount up in the starting rooms in Warsong Gulch.
  • The Battle for Alterac Valley quests now require level 58 to accept.
Professions
  • Fixed a bug that allowed for certain Waylaid Crate conversions to reward an obsolete turn-in item. Players affected can now turn these crates in for the intended reward.
  • Various Paletusks can no longer be pickpocketed
  • Blacksmithing
    • The quest “The Old Ways” now grants the Orcish War Leggings recipe via an item. Players who did not receive their recipe, or lose it, can acquire a replacement from Sumi inside the nearby blacksmithing hut once the quest is completed.
    • Bronze Mace is now Bind on Equip (was unbound). This also allows it to be added to the Transmog Collection.
    • Craftsman’s Writ: Golden Scale Gauntlets now correctly directs players to the completion NPC when ready to turn-in.
  • Herbalism
    • Fixed a bug that prevented Cultivation from working correctly on Mageroyal.
    • Wildflowers for the quest “Her World” will no longer be tracked by Find Herb unless you are on the quest.
  • Skinning
    • Skinners can no longer skin a few creatures that typically are not skinnable.
Quests
  • A bin of mail has been discovered in SI:7 quarters and Mathias Shaw can now give rogues the letter that they’ve been expecting for “The Manor, Ravenholdt”.
  • “Show Them How It’s Done” can now be properly seen on your map.
  • Questing players should now encounter more Fen Creepers in Wetlands for “Blisters on the Land”.
  • Quest “Step One: Rock” rockpiles will now be tracked via Find Minerals (was Find Treasure) while on the quest.
  • There are now more Gravelsnout Diggers and Surveyors available for the quest “A New Ore Sample”. You may take ore sample, but we strongly advise you do not take candle.
  • Shen’dralas
    • Repairing pylon objectives for “Powering the Pylons” is now shared with nearby party members.
    • The Depleted Crystal Heart for the quest “Heart of Crystal” now drops for all players in a party.
    • Rokren for the Gelkis escort quest “Going Home” has had his escape speed reduced.
    • Miners can now track “Spectral Iron Ore”.
    • Spectral Iron Ore spawn rate increased.
    • Reduced the frequency that Bristleback Skullcrushers cast their abilities.
    • Reduced the frequency that Decrepit Pylon Protectors cast their abilities.
    • Summon Undead Ravager cast by various necromancers can now be interrupted.
    • The quest “Agamaggan’s Blood” is no longer a Dungeon Quest and can be completed in the elite area outside of Razorfen Downs.
User Interface
  • Fixed a bug preventing players’ ignore lists from persisting through logging out of the game.
  • Fix a UI bug with Master Swordsmith, Master Axesmith, Master Hammersmith.

contentHtml:
WoW: Forever continues to break records with over 15 million characters created and almost 1.5 billion quests completed.

Announced on X (Twitter), Blizzard announced some brand new statistics for the first two weeks of WoW: Forever's launch.
  • Characters Created: 15,160,147
  • Quests Completed: 1,480,343,357
  • Enemies Defeated: 9,786,925,806
  • Guilds Created: 140,764
  • Camping Items Used: 28,696,386
  • Parties Formed: 71,309,889
  • Deadlist Boss: Archmage Arugal (Shadowfang Keep)
  • PvP kill: 28,938,569s
  • Players Deaths: 196,851,761
   


Holly Longdale also announced on Twitter that there are more people playing Forever weekly than seen in WoW in 15 years!
